subject: Junior Engineer (Fresher)
paragraphs: I am writing to express my interest in the Junior Engineer (Fresher) role at Cornerstone. As a final-year Computer Science and Engineering student, I am excited to start my career in full stack development and contribute to real-world applications.

Through coursework and projects, I have built basic web interfaces with React, implemented simple REST APIs, and worked with SQL databases for data storage and retrieval. I have foundational exposure to C#/.NET for backend logic and am comfortable assisting with testing, bug fixes, and small automation improvements.
I can assist with UI updates, API integration, and SQL query work while following team guidance and coding standards to deliver reliable changes.

I am interested in AI and machine learning and eager to support integrating ML features into applications. I value clear communication, teamwork, and continuous learning, and I would welcome the opportunity to grow with the Cornerstone engineering team.
